experiment.section: W1 PT-RISK: injury-history playing-time adjustment in fa_projection PT

a_priori_choices: 2020 excluded as a TARGET in training and scoring (60-game realized PA vs a full-season Marcel prediction is degenerate by construction; mirrors proj_eval's deliberate COVID gap in its default bases), so dev pool = {2019, 2021}; 2020 kept as a FEATURE season
ridge alpha 1.0 on z-standardized features, NO intercept: mean-zero redistribution, no global recalibration (frozen feature list carries no constant)
MLB-team transactions only (sportId=1 team ids); placement = 'placed' + injured/disabled list; activation = activated/reinstated/returned + injured/disabled list; transfers continue the stint
stint closes at earliest of next activation / next placement / placement-season window end (Apr 1 - Oct 1; 2020: Jul 23 - Sep 28); days = window overlap; stint counts to placement year
career features sum all observed seasons < B (substrate floor 2015); hook coverage rule: mlbam + age known and target_season - 1 >= 2016
row universe mirrors proj_eval (hist in B-1..B-3, age row, non-None projection); absent season B = 0 realized PA / IP / WAR; war_actual built exactly as proj_eval builds it
ON path scored through the shipped hook (EEPHUS_PT_RISK=1 with point-in-time blocks installed in fa_projection._pt_risk_state)
h1 WAR pred = round(max(0, war_from_projection), 2), the champion _decay_path t=0 cell

stop_d.bar: reconstructed MLB IL stints 2016-2025 >= 15000 and per-year counts plausible vs the registered ~1500-2500/yr scale
stop_d.reconstruction_bug_check: faithful, not a parsing hole: across 2015-2026 only 1 MLB SC transaction has an empty description and 0 injured/disabled-list rows match no verb (placed/activated/reinstated/returned/transferred). Per-year counts track published MLB IL records closely (2017 ~700 placements in the first 10-day-IL season vs 694 here; 2018 ~737 vs 730), so the registered ~1500-2500/yr plausibility scale overestimated true MLB IL volume (~550-900/yr pre-COVID, ~850-1500/yr 2021-2025).

join.note: join verified viable before the halt: 2685 distinct persons carry reconstructed MLB IL stints

loss_ledger.story: Data-blocked, not mechanism-refuted. The transactions substrate itself is sound (139 monthly files cached, IL placement/activation pairing clean, per-year counts match published MLB IL records), but the reconstruction yields 8271-scale stints for 2016-2025 against the registered 15000 floor because the registered plausibility scale overestimated real MLB IL volume. Per the frozen one-attempt rule the bar is not retuned after seeing data; the lane halts before any ridge fit, the dev and holdout bases stay untouched, and the hook ships guarded to no-op.
loss_ledger.keep_alive: Registered in GATES.md W1: re-gate at extended IL history (2027), or with the OD-roster backfill. The cached .cache/mlb_transactions/ substrate and tools/pt_risk_lab.py gate machinery are reusable as-is; a future registration can set its stint floor from the now-measured true scale.

w1b.amendment: docs/wills-2026-07-23/GATES.md section 'W1-B amendment': STOP-D floor re-derived from the PUBLISHED IL-record scale to 6000 stints 2016-2025 with per-year band 450-2600 (2021 COVID-IL era allowed high). C1-C4, the frozen feature list, arms, seeds, clamps, and the dev/holdout split are IDENTICAL to the W1 registration; the C-clauses never ran under W1 and run ONCE here.

reading.story: ARM-H: dev PA MAE 164.02 -> 161.1789 (lo95 1.394), holdout 161.7503 -> 164.9069; WAR h1 delta dev -0.006 / holdout 0.012; verdict FAIL. ARM-P: dev IP MAE 32.1582 -> 32.1415 (lo95 -0.1633), holdout 31.5623 -> 32.6268; WAR h1 delta dev 0.0045 / holdout 0.0133; verdict FAIL.
reading.mechanism: IL history redistributes projected PT from injury-prone to durable players (mean-zero ridge, no global shift); the incumbent Marcel PT already shrinks toward recent exposure, so the arm only wins where injury history adds signal BEYOND depressed prior-season playing time itself.

loss_ledger.story: Mechanism-refuted at the registered bars, not data-blocked: the amended STOP-D cleared (8271 stints 2016-2025, every year inside the 450-2600 band) and the C-clauses ran ONCE on the frozen protocol. The hitter dev-side signal is real (dev PA MAE -2.84, player-clustered lo95 +1.39) but does not transfer: holdout PA MAE degrades by 3.16 (2022-2024), holdout h1 WAR MAE degrades +0.012 vs the +0.005 bar, and the mean-zero-at-fit ridge stops being mean-zero out of population (pooled PT drift 3.5 percent vs the 2 percent C4 bar; holdout drift 4.7 percent). Pitchers show the same holdout reversal with no dev signal to begin with (dev improvement 0.017 IP, lo95 -0.16). Reading: post-2021 IL usage runs roughly 40 percent above the pre-COVID training seasons the forward chains fit on, so coefficients learned there add net PT in 2022-2024 instead of redistributing it. Marginal = FAIL stands; nothing was retuned after gate data was seen.
loss_ledger.keep_alive: Unchanged from W1: re-gate at extended IL history (2027) or with the OD-roster backfill. Ledgered for any FUTURE registration (not applied here): the measured failure mode is an IL-regime shift between train and apply eras, so a fresh registration should pre-commit an era-matched training window or per-era feature standardization.
